context.scope: verification before and after, plus open/drop overhead excluded from observed window; observer overhead included; diagnostic only, no ZIP comparison/qualification

source_inspection.index_walk_and_decode: Includes Index::visit_owned page traversal plus catalogue visitor record decoding and fragment collection into staging vectors. Final typed fragment-to-file assembly, node/fragment validation, and validate_fragments occur after visit returns and are timed under typed_validation.
source_inspection.storage_length_checks: Each authenticated_index Index::read calls RootRef::read_verified; read_verified calls storage.len() before each primary/mirror read attempt. Thus open traversal repeats storage-length checks per page/copy attempt; there is no cached sealed/physical length in this path.
